ai_summary: This financial disclosure reports that the Guttikonda group, identified as non-promoters, increased their stake in BILCARE LIMITED from 14.46% to 16.47% through an open market acquisition, representing a 2.01% rise in their collective shareholding. A major red flag is the stated acquisition date of September 17, 2026, which falls in the future relative to the document's filing date, further compounded by inconsistencies in individual shareholder percentages within the detailed breakdown.
